lexham: Oh dear, it was going to be a failure; a complete failure, Clarissa felt it in her bones as dear old Lord Lexham stood there apologising for his wife who had caught cold at the Buckingham Palace garden party.
What Lord Lexham was saying was that his wife would not wear her furs at the garden party because “my dear, you ladies are all alike”--Lady Lexham being seventy-five at least!
lexington:
Her triple suit as sweet
As when 't was cut at Lexington,
And first pronounced "a fit."

Archer connected it in his mind with a little house beyond Lexington Avenue in which beribboned window curtains and flower-boxes had recently appeared, and before whose newly painted door the canary-coloured brougham of Miss Fanny Ring was frequently seen to wait.
